en.description:
This card can only be attached to [R] Pokémon. This card provides [R] Energy only while this card is attached to a [R] Pokémon.
 If this card is discarded by an attack of the [R] Pokémon this card is attached to, attach this card from your discard pile to that Pokémon after attacking.

fr.name: Énergie Combustion
fr.description:
Cette carte ne peut être attachée qu'à un Pokémon [R] . Cette carte ne fournit de l'Énergie [R] que pendant qu'elle est attachée à un Pokémon [R] .
 Si cette carte est défaussée par une attaque du Pokémon [R] auquel cette carte est attachée, attachez cette carte de votre pile de défausse au Pokémon après votre attaque.

attacks.name: Hard Face
attacks.description: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Shieldon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Shield Attack
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Tsunami
attacks.description: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Force Regeneration
attacks.description: Put a Basic Pokémon V from your opponent's discard pile onto their Bench. If you do, put damage counters on that Pokémon until its remaining HP is 30.

attacks.name: Régénération Forcée
attacks.description: Placez un Pokémon-V de base de la pile de défausse de votre adversaire sur son Banc. Dans ce cas, placez des marqueurs de dégâts sur ce Pokémon-là jusqu'à ce qu'il ne lui reste que 30 PV.

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rayon Chargé
attacks.description: Lancez une pièce. Si c'est face, attachez une carte Énergie de votre pile de défausse à ce Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hidden Power
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Sand Pit
attacks.description: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Dust Devil
attacks.description: Does 10 damage to each non-[F] Pokémon in play. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.description: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Mania
attacks.description: Lancez une pièce. Si c'est pile, ce Pokémon s'inflige aussi 60 dégâts. Si c'est face, cette attaque inflige 60 dégâts supplémentaires.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.description: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.description: Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

en.name: Professor Rowan
en.description: Choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle the rest of your cards into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Rampaging Fang
attacks.description: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Croc Furieux
attacks.description: Défaussez 3 Énergies de ce Pokémon.
